title: Exact execution of the expanded machine
statement: Let $x$, $pat$, and $ws$ be finite Boolean words, and let $s\in\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $\operatorname{Nat.ofDigits}_2(ws)=s$. For each $j\in\mathbb{N}$, let $w_j$ be the word obtained from $ws$ by applying $j$ times the operation that subtracts one from a nonempty binary word and leaves the word unchanged when subtraction is undefined; let $C(ws,r)=\sum_{j=0}^{r-1}(2\ell_j+2)$, where $\ell_j$ is the length of the initial string of false entries in $w_j$. Suppose a configuration $d$ of the three-work-tape machine constructed from $pat$, on input $x$, has state equal to the counter-decrement running state, and its third work tape at every offset $p$ from its head with $-1\le p\le |ws|$ contains the buffer representation of $ws$ at offset $p$. Set $t=s(|pat|+1)+C(ws,s+1)$. After $t$ steps, the machine is in its done state; the third work tape contains true throughout the interval of $|ws|$ cells beginning at its initial head position, the second work tape contains $s$ consecutive copies of $pat$ throughout the interval of $s|pat|$ cells beginning at its initial head position, and every other tape cell retains its initial content. The machine is not in the done state at any time $u<t$, and at every time $u\le t$ each work-tape head is at distance at most $s|pat|+|ws|+1$ from its initial position.
hypotheses_covered: Natural number $s$ with binary value of $ws$ equal to $s$
Initial configuration state is the counter-decrement running state
Third work tape matches the buffer representation of $ws$ for every integer offset $p$ with $-1\le p\le |ws|$
Exact final state, tape contents, and second-tape head position after $t$ steps
No earlier visit to the done state
Every work-tape head remains within distance $s|pat|+|ws|+1$ of its initial position through time $t$
